rubriker.title: Respect over results: Sebastian Poltorak and Tin Jingyao receive Gligoric Trophy 2026
rubriker._rss_content: Sebastian Poltorak of Poland and Singaporean grandmaster Tin Jingyao have been named recipients of the 2026 Svetozar Gligoric Trophy. Poltorak was recognised for agreeing to a draw after his opponent became unwell during the European Club Cup, while Tin declined to claim a forfeit win when his opponent arrived late because of traffic. The appointed commission said both cases reflected exemplary fair play and respect for opponents over immediate competitive advantage. | Photo: FIDE

rubriker.title: Learning strategy from Bent Larsen
rubriker._rss_content: Bent Larsen combined an unconventional approach to the opening with a strong understanding of dynamic positions. In the 20th volume of the ChessBase Master Class series, several experts examine different aspects of the Danish star's play. The strategy section includes his 1968 win over Florin Gheorghiu in Monte Carlo, a game in which Larsen used active piece play and structural imbalances to make the most of a lasting initiative.

rubriker.title: Albrecht-Beer-Turnier 2026
rubriker._rss_content: Den fjerde utgaven av tyske Albrecht-Beer-Turnier ble spilt fra 1. til 4. oktober 2026. Det var tre nordmenn blant de 128 deltakere. Turneringen besto av 7 runder langsjakk over fire dager. IM Helge Nordahl (2289) startet med remis i første runde, men tok deretter seks strake seire. Dermed gikk Nordahl helt til topps med sine Les mer

rubriker.title: Confirmed: Abdusattorov's Olympiad Year Ends With an Engagement
rubriker._rss_content: A photo of a couple at a flower-draped engagement ceremony showed up on Uzbekistan Chess Federation's social media over the weekend, captioned only with an Uzbek phrase wishing a young couple happiness. It looked like Nodirbek Abdusattorov at the time, though the post itself never named him.

rubriker.title: The Assassination Plot Against Kasparov Is Now a Federal Case
rubriker._rss_content: Garry Kasparov has spent over a decade as Russia's most prominent chess export turned Kremlin critic, and the US Justice Department now says Russian intelligence was actively plotting to have him killed.
